def week_number_simple(year, month, day):
    cumulative = [0, 31, 59, 90, 120, 151, 181, 212, 243, 273, 304, 334]
    leap = year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)
    doy = cumulative[month - 1] + day
    if leap and month > 2:
        doy += 1
    return (doy - 1) // 7 + 1
